activities:
It is necessary to intensify actions aimed at increasing efficiency in water distribution.
The reduction of losses due to leaks in networks (40-48 %), minimizes the operating costs of water production and facilitates compliance with coverage increase targets.
Likewise, we need to increase micro-metering rates (44%) and macro-metering rates (37%).
Additionally, an adjustment in the tariffs of the national-level service provider (IDAAN), which date back 34 years, should be evaluated, considering measurement, billing, and collection systems that make it possible to cover the operating and maintenance costs of the systems and infrastructures, including their renewal.
In parallel, it is necessary to promote a culture of efficient, responsible, and shared use of water, and on the other hand carry out evaluations of the costs of uninterrupted universal access to quality water and sanitation services.
Protect, recover, and conserve water sources to guarantee supply, taking into account climate changes and their impact on the production and quality of fresh water.
